facts.label: reported
facts.quote: BITS Pilani will offer full tuition fee scholarships to candidates securing ranks among the top 1,000 in its entrance examination from 2027, expanding financial assistance for high-performing students from families with an annual income of up to Rs 20 lakh.
facts.text: BITS Pilani will provide full four-year tuition scholarships to students securing ranks among the top 1,000 in BITSAT starting from 2027.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: BITS Pilani is expanding its merit-based financial assistance from 2027, offering full tuition scholarships to its top 1,000 entrance test rankers from families earning up to Rs 20 lakh annually.
facts.text: The full tuition fee waiver is available to qualifying candidates whose family income does not exceed an annual ceiling of Rs 20 lakh.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: The scholarship will cover tuition fees for all four years of undergraduate study, provided recipients maintain a minimum cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 7.5 at their respective campuses, Group Vice Chancellor V Ramgopal Rao told PTI.
facts.text: Students receiving the scholarship must maintain a minimum cumulative grade point average of 7.5 across four years of study to retain the fee waiver.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Overall, admissions from candidates in the top 1,000 ranks increased by 50% during the year.
facts.text: BITS Pilani recorded a 50% increase in admissions from candidates in the top 1,000 entrance examination ranks during 2026.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: In 2026, the number of eligible top-500 rankers who joined BITS Pilani increased by 50 pc, and the BITSAT score needed to be in that group went up from 314 to 324," Rao was quoted as saying.
facts.text: The BITSAT score needed to join the eligible top-500 cohort climbed to 324 in 2026 from 314 previously.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: BITS Pilani disbursed approximately Rs 190 crore through scholarships, fee waivers and fellowships across its First Degree, Higher Degree and PhD programmes in the academic year 2025-26.
facts.text: BITS Pilani disbursed approximately Rs 190 crore across scholarships, fee waivers, and fellowships during academic year 2025-26.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Of this, around Rs 101 crore was allocated to undergraduate First Degree students through merit-based, merit-cum-need and international student scholarships.
facts.text: Undergraduate First Degree students received Rs 101 crore in financial aid through merit, need-based, and international scholarships in 2025-26.

facts.label: reported
facts.text: BITS Pilani will offer full four-year tuition scholarships to candidates ranked among the top 1,000 in BITSAT from 2027, subject to an annual family income ceiling of Rs 20 lakh and a minimum CGPA of 7.5. The expansion follows a 50% rise in admissions from the top 1,000 rankers in 2026.
